name: simpane
description: Puts the iOS Simulator beside your Claude Code session: a live screenshot, dark mode and text size switches, your app's own logs, and tools that let Claude see the screen for itself.

refresh.title: Live refresh, in seconds
refresh.description: How often the picture is retaken while the pane is on screen and Live is on. off: only on Refresh and after a command that changes the simulator.

autoOpen.title: Open the pane
autoOpen.description: Open the pane when Claude installs, launches or builds for a booted simulator. Off: only on /simpane.
